reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Madecassoside Sticker 1P
reviews.text: loveee!!! i get why abib costs a bit more penny than others. i love how it adheres nicely to the face and moisturises it well. my skin feels more plump in the morning
reviews.zh: loveee!!!我明白點解 abib 會比其他人貴少少。我好鍾意佢貼面又保濕得好。朝早起身皮膚感覺更加飽滿。

reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Collagen Milk Sticker 1P
reviews.text: I ordered it twice and really liked it. It was a great buy. I ordered it twice and really liked it. It was a great buy.
reviews.zh: 我訂咗兩次，真係好鍾意。好值得買。我訂咗兩次，真係好鍾意。好值得買。

reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Heartleaf Sticker 1P
reviews.text: It is so adhesive to skin, you can feel the face is fully moisturized and do soft after first use. Love it!
reviews.zh: 佢好貼膚，第一次用完就可以 feel 到塊面完全保濕又變軟。好鍾意！

reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Madecassoside Sticker 1P
reviews.text: This face mask is quite good. It provides enough hydration and nourishment, but the effect doesn’t last too long — by the next day the feeling is mostly gone.
reviews.zh: 呢個面膜幾好。保濕同營養都夠，但效果唔太持久——到第二日感覺就差唔多散晒。

reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Heartleaf Sticker 1P
reviews.text: The design and packaging really speak to me. The texture feels very comfortable, and it looks really soothing
reviews.zh: 設計同包裝真係好啱我。質地感覺好舒服，望落好舒緩

reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Heartleaf Sticker 1P
reviews.text: It was very cooling and quite soothing, however some areas, especially around my lips felt quite dry after.
reviews.zh: 非常涼爽又幾舒緩，不過用完之後有啲位，特別係嘴唇周圍，感覺幾乾。

reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Sedum Hyaluron Sticker 1P
reviews.text: A lot of serum, I mean seriously a lot… very hydrating and i like the mask texture, but I found serum is too thin and dripping everywhere. Kinda messy.
reviews.zh: 超多精華，我係講真係超多…好保濕，而且我鍾意塊面膜嘅質地，但我發覺精華太稀，滴到周圍都係。有啲亂。

reviews.shade: Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Collagen Milk Sticker 1P
reviews.text: The ABIB Gummy line is the best! Enough serum in just one packet to coat my entire face 4x over!
reviews.zh: ABIB Gummy 系列最正！一包嘅精華足夠塗勻成塊面四次！
